Synteq is a developer cloud running our own hardware and network. We do large-scale bare-metal, GPU, VPS, storage, and PaaS deployments across 5 US datacenters.

- Growth Lead: own top of funnel for a developer cloud product, covering SEO, community, PLG, and partnerships. Open to people new to growth or with some experience. https://synteq.com/career/growth-lead

- Systems Administrator: Proxmox hypervisors, networking, physical builds, Ceph, and bare metal. Ideally 2–15 YOE.
